claim_text: Excessive zinc intake over time can interfere with copper absorption and lead to copper deficiency; total elemental zinc exposure from multiple supplements and medicines should be reviewed before adding another zinc product.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent excessive zinc intake and secondary copper deficiency.

population.sex_or_life_stage: Pregnancy and lactation have distinct reference values.
population.health_status: People using zinc-containing supplements or multiple products.
population.other_context: Risk depends on elemental dose, duration and individual context.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Elemental zinc from supplements, multivitamins, lozenges and zinc-containing medicines.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Zinc Health Professional Fact Sheet describes upper intake limits and copper-related adverse effects associated with excessive zinc exposure.
limitations: Compound mass is not equivalent to elemental zinc.
Do not diagnose copper deficiency from supplement history alone.
Symptoms or suspected deficiency require professional and laboratory assessment.
